fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 在桥上，72 根荧光棒平均分给 8 个朋友，每人几根？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 10 lanterns hang on the bridge, and 1/2 of them are gold. How many lanterns are gold?
questions.q_zh: 桥上挂着 10 个灯笼，其中 1/2 是金色的，金灯笼有多少个？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A rectangular lantern stand on the bridge is 24 dm long and 13 dm wide. Flora wraps red ribbon once around its edge. How many decimetres of ribbon does she need?
questions.q_zh: 桥上有个长方形灯笼台，长 24 分米、宽 13 分米。Flora 用红绸沿边绕一圈，需要多少分米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A red carpet for the bridge's lantern show is 10 m long and 5 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯会铺的红地毯长 10 米、宽 5 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora rides 8 km from the hutong to the Seventeen-Arch Bridge, then walks 150 m onto the bridge. How many metres does she travel in all?
questions.q_zh: Flora 从胡同骑 8 千米到十七孔桥，又走了 150 米上桥，一共走了多少米？
questions.qtype_zh: 单位换算（米↔厘米、千克↔克）
